m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Voila! It's that disrespectful wizard Clooso told us about. Haha! This is how I get promoted to Chief Inspector!
No! This is how I get promoted to Chief Inspector!
Aha! The intruder intrudes again. And not this time am I not surprised. Wait, did I say that right? Never you mind, fiend!
To arms, Inspectors! The intruder is at the top of our game! None can know that the Brigade is up to this fishy business!
There is a time to laugh and a time not to laugh, and this is... not one of them. Bah! I'm even outdone in my own words!    \n
<ITALICS>The Harbormaster's Report lists all the shipments being delivered to the Walruskberg Harbor. </ITALICS> \n
<ITALICS>A ship called the Sea Chicken is listed as arriving with several Imported Tuna Crates.</ITALICS>
Good work. Now, comes the fun part.
If you haven't realized it yet, the Empress has become as mad as a colony of Sea Monkeys. To outlaw fishing? And this curfew? It cannot stand.
This is a revolution. We will free everyone from the Basstille and bring down the Walrusk regime. First, they must know we've had enough.
We will dump their rotten, stinking Imported Fish into the harbor! One of the ships on the docks has many crates, but we don't know which ship.
If you will go to the Inspectors Brigade Headquarters and get the Harbormaster's Report, we can find out. Do this and you will earn our trust.
We won't know which ship has the imported fish until you get us the Harbormaster's Report. Good luck!
